# Holy Hornet UAV Systems

> Holy Hornet is an independent UAV (drone) consultancy and systems company based in Europe (Netherlands). It designs, integrates and operates unmanned aircraft for surveillance, inspection, mapping, logistics, agriculture and counter-drone defence, and trains teams to fly them. Slogan: "Advanced UAV solutions for a safer tomorrow."

- Website: https://holyhornet.com/
- Contact: info@holyhornet.com or https://holyhornet.com/contact.html
- Region: Europe

## Pages

- [Home](https://holyhornet.com/): Holy Hornet designs, integrates and operates UAV systems for surveillance, inspection, mapping, logistics, agriculture and counter-drone defence across Europe.
- [Solutions](https://holyhornet.com/solutions.html): UAV strategy and consultancy, systems integration, mission planning, drone operations, payload and sensor integration, and team training from Holy Hornet.
- [Industries](https://holyhornet.com/industries.html): Drone capability for infrastructure, energy, public safety, security and counter-drone, agriculture, media, logistics, research and environmental survey.
- [Systems](https://holyhornet.com/systems.html): 26 Holy Hornet UAV simulation and control projects: a 102-drone swarm formation show, multi-UAV path planning with Grey Wolf Optimiser, RRT* planning, PID, LQR, MPC, NMPC, backstepping, sliding-mode and fuzzy flight control, SLAM, reinforcement learning, counter-UAS tracking and full hexacopter, octocopter and wind-turbine inspection models.
- [Projects](https://holyhornet.com/projects.html): Perching UAV, an interactive simulator that runs in the browser (https://holyhornet.com/projects/perching-uav/): a drone that finds a compatible steel surface or bar, attaches with electropermanent magnets or a claw, verifies the grip, switches its motors off to work as a sensor station, then checks battery, wind, airspace, motors and release before detaching. All results are simulated. SkyShield, a live browser demo of a passive drone detection and tracking console (https://holyhornet.com/projects/skyshield/): simulated radar, RF, Remote ID, camera and acoustic sensors fused into one airspace picture with alerts; detection only, a development prototype with no field results yet.
- [Education](https://holyhornet.com/education.html): Practical UAV and pilot courses: drone engineering, aerial photography, remote pilot licence (RPA-L) theory, private pilot licence PPL(A) theory, specific category operations and systems engineering.
- [About](https://holyhornet.com/about.html): Holy Hornet is an independent UAV consultancy and systems company in Europe that advises on, integrates, operates and develops drone systems.
- [Contact](https://holyhornet.com/contact.html): Contact Holy Hornet about drone consultancy, choosing an aircraft from our fleet, systems integration, UAV operations or training. Email info@holyhornet.com.

## Services

- UAV strategy & consultancy: Requirements, technology evaluation, buying support, capability roadmaps and independent technical advice.
- Systems integration: Aircraft, payloads, radio links, ground stations and data workflows set up to work as one system.
- Mission planning: Operating concepts, site surveys, mission design, risk review and field workflows your team can repeat.
- UAV operations: Professional flights and data collection, carried out with the right authorisations and within the rules.
- Payload & sensor integration: Day, night, thermal, mapping and specialist sensors matched to what the mission needs to see.
- Training & capability: Practical training, operator workflows and system familiarisation for your own team.

## Courses

- UAV Engineering & Design: How drones are designed and built, from airframes and propulsion to power systems, components and testing.
- Aerial Photography & Cinematography: Plan and capture great aerial images using composition, camera settings, movement and careful flight preparation.
- Remote Pilot Licence (RPA-L) Theory: Aviation principles, airspace, weather, human factors and safe procedures. The exact syllabus depends on the licensing framework that applies to you.
- Specific Category UAV Operations: Planning and safety for operations beyond the open category, including risk, mitigations and paperwork where needed.
- UAV Systems Engineering: Model, simulate and control UAVs in MATLAB and Simulink, from PID to model predictive control, reinforcement learning, SLAM and swarms.
- Private Pilot Licence PPL(A) Theory: The theory subjects for the aeroplane private pilot licence, from how a wing flies to instruments, air law, weather and navigation.

## Industries

- Infrastructure & construction: Progress records, inspection, surveying, site overviews and views of hard-to-reach structures.
- Energy & utilities: Inspecting lines, towers, turbines and pipelines, with thermal checks and mapping.
- Public safety & emergency: Fast situational awareness, search support and aerial views for responders, where authorised.
- Security & counter-drone: Perimeter watch, site awareness and protection against unwanted drones, within the law.
- Agriculture: Crop spraying and seed spreading with terrain-following drones that cover big fields fast.
- Film, media & production: FPV and stabilised aerial footage for demanding commercial and creative productions.
- Logistics & delivery: Heavy-lift drones that carry equipment and supplies to sites that are hard to reach by road.
- Research & technology: Prototype aircraft, sensors and integration support for new uses of unmanned systems.
- Survey & environment: Mapping land, coastlines and habitats, and monitoring change over time.

## Notes

- Aircraft specifications are manufacturer figures; flight time depends on payload, battery and weather.
- Course details, certification and regulatory fit are confirmed with Holy Hornet before enrolment.
